messages:
Aisha Patel: Morning team  Meridian EBR next Thursday. Need to finalize deck, risk grade, and the executive ask. Can everyone post quick status updates here by EOD Thu so I can assemble slides?

Jon Ramirez: Working on usage + SLA slide. Ill toss v1 into the drive by tomorrow AM. Would like someone to sanity-check the churn curve overlay. :chart_with_downwards_trend:

Ravi Gupta: I'll own the churn overlay and onboarding KPIs. Pulling latest from Gainsight & telemetry. Plan to paste numbers here by Thu 10am.

Claire Chen: Enablement wants a short demo of the new self-serve runbook (10m). Should we treat that as part of the operations deep-dive rather than the exec summary?

Aisha Patel: Ops section makes sense for the runbook. Claire  can you produce one summary slide + one screenshot/gif of the flow? Keep it very compact.

Claire Chen: Yep, will do. Also will include the enablement asks: recommended training cadence and a suggested health playbook for low-engagement accounts.

Jon Ramirez: Uploaded draft: https://drive.redwood/meridian/ebr/draft-v2 (comments open). Please add brief notes rather than long comments so I can iterate quickly.

Ravi Gupta: Onboarding snippet for slides (copyable):
- Seats provisioned: 1,260
- Active MAUs (30d): 892
- Onboarding completion (core flows): 76%
- Avg time-to-first-success: 6.1 days

Aisha Patel: Thanks. For renewal posture  CSAT is neutral; were seeing usage drop among two power-user cohorts. I'm setting Meridian to Amber (monitoring). Proposed mitigations: 1) targeted enablement + outreach, 2) exec touchpoint, 3) short credits incentive for re-engagement.

Jon Ramirez: Can you draft a concise exec ask for the CSM to present? Something like: "Request a 30-min strategic sync + approval for a short credits pilot." Keep it 2-3 bullets.

Aisha Patel: Drafting now, will paste shortly.

Samira (CS-bot): Reminder: EBR deck must follow template. Auto-check runs in 48 hrs and will flag missing exec asks and slides>12.

Aisha Patel: Draft exec ask:
---
We request a 30-minute strategic sync between Meridian leadership and Redwood execs to: 
1) Review recent usage trends and roadmap alignment for Q3; 
2) Approve a 6-week usage credits pilot for at-risk cohorts; 
3) Endorse a quarterly enablement cadence and a technical deep-dive for the platform team.
---
Please propose edits.

Ravi Gupta: Suggest changing "6-week" to "6-week usage credits pilot" (clarity) and add target success metric: "+10% active users in targeted cohort".

Claire Chen: Add enablement commitment: "2 x 60-min customer workshops in the quarter".

Aisha Patel: Updated ask posted above. Please sign-off by EOD Thu so I can include in deck.

Jon Ramirez: From content side I'm good. I'll trim the deck to 11 slides and upload final by Mon 9am.

Ravi Gupta: Numbers and churn graph signed off from my side. Posting final CSV snippet by Thu 10am.

Claire Chen: Enablement slide signed off. Will attach GIF walkthrough and short playbook for the two at-risk accounts.

Aisha Patel: Quick action item list: 
- Jon: upload final deck (Mon 9am)
- Ravi: final onboarding metrics + annotated churn graph (Thu 10am)
- Claire: enablement summary slide + demo GIF (Thu 4pm)
- Samira (CSM): confirm exec availability & send invite (Mon EOD)
- Aisha: finalize exec ask text and coordinate runbook demo (Mon 3pm)

Samira (CS-bot): Task created: #EBR-Meridian-Prep assigned to Aisha/Jon/Ravi/Claire/Samira, due Mon.

Jon Ramirez: Also need a short synthesis of customer feedback for slide 8 (3 bullets max). I have raw quotes. Who can do a quick themes extract?

Ravi Gupta: Happy to synthesize into 3 themes by Thu afternoon.

Aisha Patel: Great. Note: if anything escalates to Red risk, renewal rep wants a pre-EBR risk huddle 24-48 hrs prior. Keep tracking the two power-user accounts.

Claire Chen: I'll draft a focused playbook for those accounts (support + enablement + product triage) and attach to the ops appendix.

Aisha Patel: Thanks all  this is moving. Ping me if blockers pop up. :thumbsup:
